scientific_integrity.certification: No third-party institutional certification or formal Lean proof is claimed.
scientific_integrity.numerical_checks: Independent finite quadrature of the specified integral and functional is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Fixed-temperature cellwise Taylor expansion with composite midpoint remainder, followed by independent endpoint asymptotics; an exact linear-dispersion boundary-layer calculation rules out an unwarranted joint-limit necessity.

scientific_limitations: The M^{-2} coefficient law holds for fixed beta as M tends to infinity, with an O(M^{-4}) constant that may depend on beta.
The low-temperature beta^{1/z} law concerns that coefficient in a subsequent limit and does not imply any necessary or sufficient joint (M,beta) cell-count scale at fixed tolerance.
For the admissible linear dispersion E(k)=pi-k and fixed M, the exact functional tends to log(2)/(2M) as beta tends to infinity.
A physical entropy-bound or preparation-complexity interpretation requires a separate model-specific derivation; finite-cell saturation is not proved.
title: Critical scaling of the finite-cell covariance lower-bound coefficient
